result.title: An Analysis of Semantic and Spatio-Temporal Co-evolution for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs
result.summary: Dynamic edge classification on text-attributed Web graphs, such as review networks, community forums, and news-derived knowledge graphs, requires high quality, adaptive semantic representations in the context of network evolution. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically initialize text feature vectors with pretrained language models and hold them static during training to preserve their semantic structure, forgoing the potential benefits of allowing them to co-evolve with network topology. In this work, we investigate the effects of enabling such co-evolution with a unified text-graph alignment framework that integrates a lightweight Transformer adapter to update token-level text representations via spatio-temporal gradients from a contrastive pretraining objective. To prevent detrimental semantic distortion, a language model maintenance objective anchors the evolving text embeddings to their original semantic structure. Evaluations on the Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark demonstrate that this anchored text-graph co-evolution consistently improves upon the edge classification performance of frozen-text baselines across diverse Web-related domains. Representational analyses reveal that the framework reduces anisotropy, improving the linear separability of text embeddings, and effectively encodes structural and temporal information into the semantic space. A computational efficiency analysis confirms that this beneficial semantic and spatio-temporal co-evolution is achieved without incurring the prohibitive computational overhead typical of end-to-end joint training.

AI.brief_summary: 研究动态文本属性图上的边分类，提出统一的文本-图对齐框架：用轻量 Transformer adapter 依据对比预训练的时空梯度更新 token 级文本表示，并以语言模型维持目标锚定原始语义结构，在动态文本属性图基准上验证性能与表示各向异性的改善。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「锚定式」表示协同演化与防语义漂移的正则化，可能为 LVR 中训练期 latent 状态如何既更新又保留视觉/任务信息提供可核查线索；文中各向异性与线性可分性的表示分析，也可供考察 latent 相似度结构的借鉴。
